tei:div.tei:p: (nga )༄༅// mahākāruṇikapriyonayānārthanishtsayabasantantilakabhāṣaṇasyakaṭālaṃkāranāmabidzahāraṃ//

༄༅// thugs rje chen po'i smar khrid nges don dpyid kyi thig le 'chad par byed pa'i zur rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ dus gsum sangaṃs rgyasaṃ kyis kun gyis gshegs pa'i lam// ma lus legs par 'doms pa'i blo gros can// dpaṃl ldan bla ma phrin las bzaṃng po dang*// 'phags mchog phyag na padmas rtag tu skyongs// chos brgyad rtog pa'i bgo ba zegs byas pa// chog shes bag yod ldan pa'i rgyas btab nas// sgrub la brtson pas tshe 'dir lhag pa'i lha// nges par grub pa'i slob dpon tshem bu pa// de las 'ongs pa'i gsang chen sngags kyi lam// kun tshang nor pa med pa'i dmar khrid ces// 'phrin yig phyogs bral mkhas pa'i snying ga ru// rnam gsal gang de 'chad pa'i zur rgyan brtsam// 'dir bsil ldan kha ba'i ljongs kyi grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po gnyen tshem bu pa'i lugs kyi thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid ces yongs su grags pa de nyid 'chad pa la/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang thob pa'i slob ma rnams bsdus nas gral la 'khod par me tog bkye ba grub nas/ dpon slob thams cad kyis ngag tu/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo// oṃ badzra sa twa sa ma ya zhes sogs kyis rdo rje sems dpa' 'am/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo zhes dang*/ he ru ka'i yi ge brgya pa gang rung myur bar nyer gcig tsam bzlas pa'i mthar/ de dang bstun pa'i mjug gi bshags sdom phyag 'tshal bstod de'am bdag ni mi shes sogs nas byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes pa'i bar brjod/ de nas shes shing nus na dmar khrid brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs zhig slob dpon gyis bskul nas 'don/ de bar mchod g.yog pas zlum gtor bshams pa la chab kyis brin/ slob dpon gyis/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ

oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥrnams lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ phaiṃ badzra a ra li hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ḍā ki nī sa ma ya st+waṃ dṛ shya hoḥ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba yakṣa sogs lan gsum dang*/ oṃ badzra puṣpe sogs nas shabda'i bar dang*/ oṃ sarba ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang zhes sogs nas yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog ces pa'i bar brjod la/ mtheb srin gyis se gol dang*/ oṃ badzra muḥzhes pas gshegs su gsol lo// gzhan rnams kyis brgyud 'debs sogs kyi mtha' rdzogs ma thag nas/ mchod g.yog pas maṇḍal bskul nas thams cad kyis maṇḍal 'bul/ de nas slob dpon gyis zang zing med pa'i byams pa dang 'khor ba las bsgral 'dod kyi snying rje chen po dang ldan bzhin pas/ 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sogs kyis sems bskyed gsal btab nas/ nyi ma dang po la/ de la 'dir gang gsan par bya ba'i dam pa'i chos ni bla ma rnams kyi snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa bar ma chad pa zhes sogs nas/ dmar khrid ces bya ba ste mtshan gyi rnam grangs drug dang ldan pa'i lam bzang 'di nyid ni gang bshad par bya ba'i chos so// 'di 'chad par byed pa la gsum ste/ theg pa dang mdo rgyud gang du gtogs ngos gzung ba/ ngos zin pa de gang las byung ba'i bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar bstan pa/ brgyud pa de dang ldan pa'i gdams pa dngos bshad pa'o// dang po theg pa dang mdo rgyud gang du gtogs ngos gzung ba ni bstan pa 'di'i bdag po ston pa mnyam med shākya'i rgyal pos gdul bya rnams kyi bsam pa dang bag la nyal sna tshogs pa la dgongs nas dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsungs te/ 'phags mchog klu sgrub zhabs kyis zhes sogs nas/ 'di bod kyi grub chen gnyen tshem bu par grags pa la ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro mas dngos su gnang ba'i gdams ngag khyad par can de nyid do// gnyis pa ngos zin pa de gang las byung ba'i bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar bstan pa ni gdams pa 'di'i brgyud pa'i gtso bo grub chen gnyen tshom bu pa de nyid sogs nas dkyus nas 'byung ba'i rnam thar thor bu rdzogs pa'am/

grub chen de nyid kyi rnam thar gyi rjes su/ grub chen des skal ldan gyi slob ma drug la gnang yang*/ deng sang chos kyi brgyud pa la bzhugs pa ni/ byang sems spyi bo lhas pa dang*/ nye gnas 'che brag pa gnyis yin la/ de gnyis las ji ltar brgyud pa'i tshul ni/ byang chub sems dpa' spyi bo lhas pa'i drung du/ stag sde brag dmar ba byang chub tshul khrims kyis gsan/ de la lha btsun dgon gsar ba tshul khrims grags pas gsan/ de las kun spangs chen po thugs rje brtson 'grus kyis gsan/ yang 'che brag pa'i drung du stag ston spyil bu bas gsan/ de las kun spangs chen pos gsan/ spro na de nas rim bzhin byang sems rgyal ba ye shes/ chos rje gzhon seng ba/ 'phags mchog bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ theg chen chos kyi rgyal po kun dga' bkra shis/ thugs sras dpal ldan legs pa/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan/ rdo rings kun spangs chen po kun bzang chos kyi nyi ma/ mkhas grub kun dga'i mtshan can/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug grub mchog dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ rgyal rtse ba ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bod chen gyi btsun pa sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mkhas btsun chen po kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa chen po sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ des bdag la dgyes bzhin du bka' drin du stsal ba lags/ yang na jo nang kun spangs pa yan gong bzhin las/ kun spangs nas/ brag kha ba grags pa seng ge sgro smon pa rin chen dpal bzang*/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ 'ba' rwa ba rgyal mtshan dpal bzang*/ rtogs ldan rin chen 'phel/ zhwa lu pa 'khrul zhig tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ sku zhang mkhyen rab chos rje/ rdo rings pa man chad gong bzhin no zhes sam/ bsdu na kun spangs nas rim pa bzhin du bdag cag gi rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar gyi brgyud pa bar ma chad pa las legs par 'ongs pa ste/

bla ma phyi ma dag gi lo rgyus rnams kyang sang nyin nas rim pa bzhin du 'byung ba lags zhes pa tsam gyis 'thus/ de lta bu'i bla ma brgyud pa'i khungs dang mi ldan na/ rigs med kyi nal bu dang 'dra ste yid brtan du mi rung ngo zhes gsungs so// gsum pa brgyud pa de dang ldan pa'i gdams pa dngos la/ bkri bya'i gzhi ngos gzung ba/ 'khrid byed kyi thabs bstan pa/ de ltar khrid pa'i 'bras bu ste gsum las/ dang po bkri bar bya ba'i gzhi ni sems gsal stong zung 'jug gi bdag nyid 'gro ba thams cad la khyab pa'i gzhi bde gshegs snying po de nyid do// gnyis pa 'khrid byed kyi thabs la gnyis te/ gdan thog gcig tu bsgom pa'i man ngag nyams su blang ba'i tshul sogs nas/ gal shin tu che ste/ thun mong gi sngon 'gro de rnams rgyud la ma skyes na dngos gzhi'i khrid btab kyang nyams myong mi skye ste/ gnyid mi bro ba mal du bcug pa dang 'dra'o gsungs zhes pa'i bar dkyus ltar brjod/ sngon 'gro de rnams kyi tshig ris ni snang gsum mdzes rgyan nam/ blo sbyong sogs rang gis gang thob cing blo la gang nges pa'i steng nas rung zhing*/ 'on kyang go rim ni dal 'byor rnyed dka' sogs gong gi sa bcad ltar bya ste/ slob ma sngar snang gsum mam blo sbyong la sogs pa'i khrid thob cing nges 'byung gi bsam pa brtan po yod pa rnams la ni nan tan cher ma bshad kyang chad pa'i skyon med ces gsungs na'ang 'dir yang khrid gzhung gis dngos su smos pa ltar mdo tsam brjod na/ 'di ltar rang gzhan thams cad brnag par dka' ba'i 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po mtha' med cing gting mi dpog pa 'di nyid las thar par byed pa'i thabs la rtag 'grus su byed pa ni/ dgos pa thams cad kyi nang nas bsgrub bya'i gtso bo nyid du shes par byas nas dam pa'i chos nyams su len pa la 'bad pa bya dgos shing*/

de nyams su len pa la yang thog mar dal 'byor gyi lus rten skyon med pa zhig thob dgos pa yin na'ang*/ de ni yang nas yang du brnyed pa ma yin te/ dal 'byor 'di ni rnyed pa shin tu dka' zhes sogs nas de dag gi spyod pa la bslab pa'i bar la rgyas bsdus ci rigs pa re bshad de sde tshan re re'i mthar yang*/ des na de dag gi don la zhib tu bsams kyin dam pa'i chos rnam par dag pa zhig ci nas kyang bsgrub snyam pa'i 'dun sems smon gsum gyi sgo nas chos sgrub 'dod kyi blo bskyed cing bsgom mo zhes ji ltar 'os pa brjod de/ mthar de dag thams cad kyang sbyor ba skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ rjes bsngo ba smon lam dang dran shes brtan pa'i rkya bar na bcug ste nyams su len pa dang bcas pa rnams ni thun mong gi sngon 'gro'i khrid kyi rim pa mdor bsdus pa tsam lags/ gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro la/ rgyud snod du rung bar byed pa skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyi khrid/ sdig sgrib 'dag par byed pa yi ge brgya pa'i khrid/ tshogs rdzogs par byed pa maṇḍal gyi khrid/ byin rlabs 'jug par byed pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid dang bzhi'i dang po la gnyis/ tha mal pa dang lam log pa mu stegs byed las khyad par du bya ba skyabs 'gro dang*/ lam dman pa nyan rang las khyad par du bya ba sems bskyed do// dang po skyabs 'gro la/ rgyu yul tshul dang zhes sogs nas srung ma rnams bsam mo zhes pa'i rjes su/ tshul ni rang de dag la phyogs pa'i tshul gyis 'khod pa'i rang gi g.yas su pha/ g.yon du ma/ mdun du dgra 'dre/ mtha' skor du rigs drug bar do dang bcas pa'i sems can thams cad khrom tshogs su 'khod par mos la bla ma dang dkon mchog la blo lings kyis bkal sogs dang sbrel nas yang yang skyabs 'gro la goms par bya'o// sgra don dang dbye ba gzhan ltar bshad pa'am dkyus ltar shes par bya'o zhes brjod pas kyang btub bo// gnyis pa lam dman pa nyan rang las khyad par du bya ba sems bskyed kyi khrid ni/

de la'ang sems bskyed pa'i sngon du snying rje bsgom par bya ste/ ye shes grub pa las/ de ltar gnas shing 'khor bar ni// yun ring dus su 'jug pa na// pha dang mar ni ma gyur pa'i// sems can gang yang yod ma yin// de bzhin bu mo la sogs kun// 'gro ba drug tu sngon byung bas// de bas snying rje chen po ni// bya zhes rgyal ba rnams kyis gsungs// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ tshe rabs du ma nas pha dang ma dang phu nur gyur pa'i sems can sdug bsngal can rnams la snying rje ba'i bsam pa nye bar bzhag nas 'di ltar bsam par bya ste/ kye ma 'khor 'das gnyis snang gis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad gdod ma nas rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid can gyi lha dang ye shes kyi ngo bor 'dug pa la/ de ltar ma shes pas 'khrul pa du ma la longs spyod pa'i pha ma rigs drug gis bsdus pa'i sems can 'di rnams snying re rje/ 'di rnams kyi don du srid pa 'khor ba dang zhi ba mya ngan las 'das pa'i mtha' la mi gnas pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang de bdag gis ci nas kyang mngon du bya/ de yang rgyu med rkyen med la mi 'byung bas rgyu rkyen gyi gtso bo zab mo rdo rje theg pa'i lam tshang la ma nor ba 'di lta bu la bdag gis rnal 'byor du bya'o snyam pa'i 'dod 'dun drag po yang dang yang du bskyed nas 'dir smon 'jug gi go don ni zhes sogs dang sbrel ba nas/ 'di dag ni gong dal 'byor rnyed dka'i dmigs rkang nas bzung ste/ dmigs rkang thams cad kyi 'go mjug tu sbyar bar bya'o zhes pa'i bar brjod do// de dag gis ni de ring gi dmigs rkang gi rim pa rnams la thos bsam gyi sgro 'dogs dpyad nas/ dpyad don bsgom pas nyams su blang ba'i tshul de dag gi snying po btus te bstan pa ni/ do nub nas brtsams te rang rang gi gnas khang du bde ba'i stan la bsam gtan gyi spyod lam gyis 'dug ste/

mdun gyi nam mkhar skyabs yul bla ma rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa thams cad mngon sum lta bur bzhugs par bsams la/ de dag gi spyan sngar rang dang rang gi pha ma gnyis kyis thog drangs pa'i mkha' khyab rigs drug gis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad 'khod nas skyabs su 'gro bar bsams la skyabs 'gro dang gsol gdab tsam byas nas gong du bshad pa'i don rnams zhib tu bsam pa'i sgo nas dal 'byor rnyed dka' dang 'chi ba mi rtag pa dang*/ las rgyu 'bras dang 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs rnams dran pa'i sgo nas chos sgrub 'dod kyi blo skom pa la chu 'dod pa ltar ma byung gi bar du bsgom/ de rgyud la skyes nas sems can thams cad bde ba rgyu dang bcas pa dang phrad par 'dod pa'i byams pa dang*/ sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa dang bral bar 'dod pa'i snying rje chen po dang ldan pas/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya'o snyam pa'i smon pa dang*/ de'i ched du sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam la bslab par bgyi'o snyam pa 'jug pa byang chub kyi sems bskyed nas bdag gzhan mnyam pa dang brje ba'i sems bsgom pa dang*/ bdag gi lus longs spyod dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba'i dngos po thams cad pha ma sems can la gtong ba'i blo bskyed/ de ltar btang bas rang rang gi mdun du so so'i bsam pa dang mthun par zad mi shes par 'byung bar gyur cig snyam pa'i blo bskyed pa dang*/ dngos su yang gzhan gyi bde ba bsgrub pa dang sdug bsngal sel ba'i grogs byed pa la sogs pa'i spyod pa spyi dang*/ rang smin par byed pa pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang gzhan smin par byed pa bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi la sogs pa rgyal ba'i sras kyi spyod pa rnams la bslab bo zhes pa tsam brjod/ sngar snang gsum la sogs pa'i khrid thob cing lam rim la goms 'dris yod pa rnams la nyin grangs mang po mi byed pa'i tshe de tsam gyis chog par mdzad cing*/

de ltar min pa blo sbyong la sogs pa'i thun mong ba'i sngon 'gro'i khrid zhag grangs mang po byed par 'dod na/ so so'i gzhung nas 'byung ba ltar bshad pa dang bsgom pas nyams su blang ba'i tshul bskyar ba dang bcas pa bya'o// gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro la rgyud snod du rung bar byed pa skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyi khrid sogs nas/ dmigs rkang thams cad kyi 'go mjug tu sbyar bar bya'o pa'i bar ni sngar ltar rgyas par brjod pa'i phyag len mdzad/ slar yang de ring gi bsgom bya'i dmigs rkang de dag lan cig bskyar na/ do nub nas brtsams te rang rang gi gnas khang sogs sngar bzhin brjod pa'i mthar/ de ring gi thugs dam de la mdzad par zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid ces sogs dang*/ theg mchog dam chos rin chen bshad 'di la zhes sogs kyis slob ma rang gnas su btang ngo*// //nyi ma gnyis pa'i dmigs thun la/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sogs sems bskyed gsal 'dabs pa nas/ bsam gyis mi khyab par gsungs te zhes pa'i rjes su/ de dag phyogs ris su bsdu na 'di theg chen yin/ de la'ang rgyu dang 'bras bu'i theg pa gnyis las 'di phyi ma yin/ de la'ang rgyud sde bzhi las 'dir rnal 'byor bla na med pa yin/ bla na med pa'i rgyud kyi nyams len zhes sogs nas mkha' 'gro mas dngos su gnang ba'i gdams ngag khyad par can de nyid do// gnyis pa ngos zin pa de gang las byung ba'i bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar bstan pa ni/ 'di'i brgyud pa'i gtso bo ni bod kyi grub chen gnyen tshem bu pa de nyid yin la/ de'i sku che ba'i yon tan ni kha sang gi skabs nas song zin la/ de'i 'phros ni grub chen de'i slob ma drug snang yang*/ ding sang chos kyi brgyud pa la yod pa ni spyi bo lhas pa dang*/ nye gnas 'che brag pa gnyis yin la/ dang po'i lo rgyus ni zhes sogs nas bla ma brgyud pa'i khungs dang mi ldan na rigs med kyi nal bu dang 'dra ste yid brtan du mi rung ngo zhes gsungs so zhes pa'i bar gyi rnam thar tshang bar brjod do// gsum pa brgyud pa de dang ldan pa'i gdams pa dngos la gsum ste/

bkri bya'i gzhi ngos gzung ba/ 'khrid byed kyi thabs bstan pa/ de ltar khrid pa'i 'bras bu'o// de'i bar pa 'khrid byed kyi thabs la gnyis/ gdan thog gcig tu bsgom pa'i man ngag nyams su blang ba'i tshul dang*/ de las gzhan du bsgom pa'i man ngag nyams su blang ba'i tshul lo// dang po la sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi dang*/ rjes gsum gyi dang po la yang thun mong gi sngon 'gro dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro ste gnyis/ de'i dang po la dal 'byor rnyed dka' dang 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsam pa/ las rgyu 'bras dang 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam pa/ byams pa dang snying rje bsgoms pa/ smon pa dang 'jug pa'i byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed cing de dag gi spyod pa la slob pa rnams so// gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro la/ rgyud snod du rung bar byed pa skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyi khrid/ sdig sgrib 'dag par byed pa yi ge brgya pa'i khrid/ tshogs rdzogs par byed pa maṇḍal gyi khrid/ byin rlabs 'jug par byed pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid dang bzhi las/ dang po yan chad kha sang nas song zin yang*/ da dung lan gcig bskyar na/ gsum pa brgyud pa de dang ldan pa'i gdams ngag dngos la don gsum gyi dang po bkri bya'i gzhi ni/ sems gsal stong zung 'jug gi bdag nyid sogs nas/ dmigs rkang

thun mong gi sngon 'gro rnams sa bcad tsam las rgyas par ma grub kyang rung*/ thams cad kyi 'go mjug tu sbyar bar bya'o'i bar kha sang bzhin rgyas par brjod do// de rnams kyis kha sang gi dmigs rkang rnams song*/ da ni de ring gi dmigs rkang gsar du 'chad pa la/ gnyis pa sdig sgrib 'dag par byed pa yi ge brgya pa'i khrid ni/ bla ma gnyen gyi gsung las sogs nas maṇḍal dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid zhing la sa bon btab pa dang 'dra'o// de rnams kyis de ring gi dmigs rkang song nas/ bsgom pas nyams su blang ba'i tshul bskyar ba sogs sngar gyi rigs bsgres la bla ma'i rnal 'byor yang sogs khongs su mi bsdu bar mchod pa dang maṇḍal bzhag pa tsam ma gtogs lta ba skyong ba'i bar maṇḍal gyi skabs ltar brjod pa phyag len la mdzad do// //nyi ma gsum pa la sems bskyed gsal gdab pa nas brtsams te/ 'di'i brgyud pa'i gtso bo bod kyi grub chen gnyen tshem bu pa de nyid yin la zhes pa'i bar nyi ma gnyis pa ltar brjod pa'i rjes su/ de nas rim pa bzhin du bdag cag gi rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar brgyud pa bar ma chad pa las 'ongs pa yin te/ de lta bu'i bla ma brgyud pa'i khungs dang mi ldan na zhes sogs nas byin rlabs 'jug par byed pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid dang bzhi'o zhes pa'i bar gyi sa bcad rnams nyi ma gnyis pa ltar brjod pa'i rjes su/ spro na/ dang po la lam log pa las khyad par du bya ba skyabs 'gro/ lam dman pa las khyad par du bya ba sems bskyed do// dang po la/ rgyu yul tshul dang phan yon dang*// bslab bya sgra don dbye ba'o// zhes pa ltar bdun no// gnyis pa sems bskyed la yang sems bskyed pa dngos dang*/ de'i bslab bya ste gnyis so// gnyis pa sdig sgrib 'dag par byed pa rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas la/ lha bsgom pa/ sngags bzla ba/ 'jug bshags bsdam bya ba phan yon te bzhi'o// gsum pa tshogs rdzogs par byed pa maṇḍal gyi khrid la yul gsal gdab pa/

mchod cing dngos grub blang ba/ lta ba skyong ba ste gsum mo// bzhi pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor la yang bla ma bsgom pa/ gsol ba btab nas dbang blang ba/ lta ba bskyang ba ste gsum las zhes brjod/ bsdu na bar 'di ma brjod kyang rung ngo*// gang ltar yang*/ gnyis pa sdig sgrib 'dag par byed pa yi ge brgya pa'i zhes pa nas drod gsher dang bral ba'i zhing la sa bon btab pa dang 'dra'o// de rnams kyis kha sang gi dmigs rkang rnams grub nas/ da ni de ring gi dmigs rkang gsar du 'chad pa ni/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bskyed rim bsgom pa/ rdzogs rim bsgom pa/ zung 'brel phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa'o// dang po la mngon byang lnga las dam tshig pa bskyed pa/ sems dpa' sum brtsegs bsgom pa/ sgo gsum byin gyis brlabs pa/ 'od zer gyi spro bsdu bya ba/ bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor zhar byung dang bcas pa ste lnga las/ dang po dam tshig pa bskyed pa la'ang rgyu tshogs gnyis bsags pa/ 'bras bu lha bskyed pa gnyis kyi/ dang po bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa ni/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med pa bzhi bsgom pa ste/ de yang dmigs pa sems can la dmigs nas/ rnam pa bde ba dang ldan par 'dod pa byams pa tshad med pa dang*/ dmigs pa sdug bsngal can gyi sems can la dmigs nas rnam pa sdug bsngal dang bral bar 'dod pa snying rje tshad med pa dang*/ de bzhin du sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral ba'i dga' ba khyad par can dang ldan par 'dod pa dga' ba tshad med pa dang*/ nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms chen po la gnas par 'dod pa btang snyoms tshad med pa ste/ tshad med bzhi sgrub thabs ltar bsgom mo// gnyis pa ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa ni skabs 'di'am 'og mngon byang dang po'i skabs su swa bhā wa'i sngags brjod de stong pa nyid la blo bzhag pa'o// gnyis pa 'bras bu lha bskyed pa ni/ mngon byang lnga ste/

de'ang 'di'i mngon byang gzhan dang cung zad mi 'dra ste 'di ltar/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sngags brjod de sogs nas/ pad zla phyag mtshan thams cad 'od kyi gong bur zhu/ yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid yi dam thugs rje chen po'i skur gyur par bsgom pa'am/ yang na skabs 'dir bdag gi bla mas sgrub thabs nyams len snying po gsal ba dang 'di gnyis phan tshun gcig gis gcig la phan 'dogs pa'i tshul gyis 'chad pas/ de'i dbang gis de nas 'byung ba'i mngon byang gi khyad par rnams kyang brjod na/ sngar ye shes tshogs bsags kyis chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong pa nyid du bsgoms pa ni stong pa nyid las byang chub pa'o sogs nas padma hrīḥdang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi skur bsgoms pa ste/ gang ltar yang sku mdog ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba sogs nas/ mngon byang lnga pa sku yongs su rdzogs pa las byang chub pa'o zhes pa'i bar dkyus ltar ro// gnyis pa sems dpa' sum brtsegs bsgom pa ni/ nyams len snying po gsal ba las sems dpa' sum brtsegs su bsgom par gsungs pa/ bsdu na ma byung kyang chad pa'i skyon med cing*/ bsgom par spro na rang gi thugs kar padma zla ba'i zhes pa nas/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar bya'o// gsum pa 'od zer gyi spro bsdu bya ba ni de nas rang gi thugs kar pad zla'i steng du hrīḥbasgom pa'am/ sems dpa' sum brtsegs bsgom pa ltar na ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros pas phyi snod kyi 'jig rten sogs nas bla ma la 'dor len byed pa la byin rlabs mi 'byung gsung zhes pa'i bar khrid gzhung ltar bya/ de'i rjes su yang 'od 'phros phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems yi dam lha tshogs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos srung nor lha rnams kyi gsung gi byin rlabs thams cad spyan drangs nas snying ga'i yi ge drug la thim par bsams pa ni gsung gi byin rlabs bsdu ba'o// 'di'i 'od zer spro bsdu phyi ma 'di khrid yig dngos las mi 'byung yang*/

de'i tho yig las 'od zer gyi spro bsdu drug sogs bya zhes dang 'di'i sgrub thabs las 'byung ba 'dir blangs nas 'chad pa phyag len yin no// de rnams kyis bsgom bya'i don la thos bsam gyi sgro 'dogs dpyad nas/ dpyad don nyams su blang ba sems 'dzin gyi rim pa ni/ de ltar bshad pa'i gong skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te/ 'di'i bar rnam rtog gzhan gyis bar ma chod par/ gsal la drag la yun thung ba// bskyed pa'i rim pa gnad du che// zhes pa ltar gyis sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprad cing shar sgom gyi tshul du nyams su blangs nas/ sems 'dzin dngos ni nga rgyal la bslab pa dang*/ rnam pa la bslab pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rdo rje gur las/ sangs rgyas nga rgyal rnal 'byor gyis// sangs rgyas nyid du nges par 'grub// ston pa sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan// dpe byad bzang po brgyad cur ldan// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ don bde stong zung du 'jug pa la rnam pa mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa'i bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po sems can thams cad la nyin mtshan dus drug tu gzigs pa'i bdag nyid can de nga yin no snyam du yang dang yang du nga rgyal bya'o// gnyis pa rnam pa la bslab pa ni/ rnam pa spyi dang bye brag gnyis las dang po ni/ de ltar rang yi dam kun 'dus/ spyi bo'i bla ma kun 'dus/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten gzhal yas khang dang*/ nang bcud kyi sems can thugs rje chen po bsgoms pa de thams cad de dang der snang ba gsal la ma 'gags pa dang*/ rang bzhin cir yang ma grub pa'i stong pa nyid gnyis so sor dbyer mi phyed pa'i zung 'jug tu shes par byas la yun ring du mnyam par gzhag ste/ 'di ni bskyed rim gyi dngos gzhi yin pas shin tu gal che'o// sems 'dzin bsdu na de tsam gyis chog par bzhed/ spro na gzhan ltar bya ba ni/ gnyis pa rnam pa bye brag la sems 'dzin pa ni/ de yang rang gi smin mtshams su mdzod spu dkar po kha ba dang dung ltar dkar ba g.yas su 'khyil pa cig yid kyis bsgom zhing sems bzung*/

gsal na gsal te 'phro bcad ces pa 'phro bzang mu la ngal gso zhing bsam gtan gyi dug dbyung*/ mi gsal na mi gsal te 'phro bcad ces pa bsgom dang zhe ma 'gras par bzang gyes byas la ngal gso zhing bsam gtan gyi dug dbyung*/ 'phro bcad kyang rnam pa wal du byed pa dang bsgom pa'i dus mi gsal la mi bsgom pa'i dus gsal na bsam gtan gyi dug yin pas/ shes pa gzhan la yengs su bcug nas ngal gso zhing bsgom/ des kyang gsal ma thebs na ngag tu dal bus brjod cing gsal 'debs pa sogs spyi ltar bya'o// de las ldang ba na bzlas pa dang rjes kyi bya ba rnams bya'o// de rnams kyis de ring gi dmigs rkang rnams song nas/ da dung bsgom pas nyams su blang ba'i tshul de dag lan cig bskyar na/ rang rang gi sgrub pa'i khang par bde ba'i stan la bsam gtan gyi spyod lam gyis 'dug la/ dal 'byor rnyed dka'i dmigs rkang nas brtsams te thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro rnams sngon du btang nas/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bskyed rim bsgom pa sogs nas/ rnam pa bye brag la sems 'dzin pa'i bar brjod/ da dung lan cig bskyar na sogs bsgom don btus la bskyar te mthar/ de ltar mngon byang lnga las lha bskyed pa/ sems dpa' sum brtsegs bsgom pa/ sgo gsum byin gyis brlabs pa/ 'od zer gyi spro bsdu drug dang*/ dngos gzhi sems 'dzin la nga rgyal la bslab pa dang*/ rnam pa la bslab pa ste de ring gi thugs dam de la mdzad par zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs 'dra'o// //nyi ma bzhi par sems bskyed gsal 'debs pa nas brtsams te byin rlabs 'jug par byed pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid dang bzhi'o zhes pa'i bar gyi sa bcad rgyas bsdus gang rigs nyi ma gsum pa ltar brjod pa'i rjes su/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bskyed rim bsgom pa/ rdzogs rim bsgom pa sogs nas bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor zhar byung dang bcas pa ste lnga las/

dang po dam tshig pa bskyed pa sogs sems 'dzin dang bcas pa bskyar/ da ni de ring gi dmigs rkang gsar du 'chad pa la/ lnga pa bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ de nas rang gi snying gar pad zla'i steng du hrīḥdakar po la yi ge drug gis bskor bar bsam pa'am/ sems dpa' sum brtsegs bsgoms pa'i thugs ka'i sngags klog pa'i tshul du bzla'o// de yang rang rkyang par ma zad spyi bo'i bla ma sogs nas 'od zer spro bsdu byas pas don grub bo zhes pa dang sems zin pa'i rtags ni rab la lha'i phyag mang po zhes pa gnyis sbrel la/ 'khyer so gsum 'dir byung yang 'og rjes thob kyi rnal 'byor skabs su bshad kyang rung bas de bzhin bya/ de ltar byas pa'i mthar sa brgyad pa mngon du byed cing mthar thug gzugs kyi sku 'grub bo zhes pa'i bar brjod/ de rnams kyis bsgom bya'i don la thos bsam gyi sgro 'dogs dpyad nas/ dpyad don nyams su blang ba sems 'dzin gyi rim pa ni/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te gsung gi byin rlabs bsdu ba'i bar ram bzlas pa'i bar nyams su blangs nas/ kha sang gi de'i steng du/ rim pa bzhin spyan gnyis dkyus ring zhing sems dpa'i lta stangs can la dkar nag 'byes pa/ ba mchog gi rdzi ma lta bu'i rdzi ma dang ldan pa'i gong du smin ma gnag pa zla tshes kyi dbyibs can/ shangs kyi gzengs mtho ba shangs bug dang bcas pa/ zhal gyi dkyil 'khor zla ba nya gang ba ltar dkar zhing rgyas pa/ mchu bimba ltar dmar zhing 'dzum pa/ snyan shal ring ba rin po che'i snyan rgyan dang bcas pa/ mgrin pa zlum rgyas ol gnyer rim pa gsum yod pa/ phyag zhabs kyi mthil thams cad dmar ba/ sor mo rnams zlum zhing sen mo zangs kyi mdog ltar dmar bas mdzes pa/ dbu skra shin tu gnag pa'i thor cog spyi bor bcings shing lhag ma sil bur grol bas rked par sleb pa/ dbu la rin po che'i prog zhu rim pa gsum dang ldan pa'i rtse mor yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i tog gis spras shing gser gyi rtse bran lnga 'od 'bar ba la rin po che sna tshogs kyi phras mdzes pa/

snyan gong gnyis su utpa las mtshan pa las dar dpyangs bskyod pa/ mtshog mar bla ma 'od dpag med kyis mtshan pa/ mgul par mgul rgyan rin po che'i gzhung gsum du byas pa'i bar rnams rin po che'i drwa bas sbrel ba/ de las ring ba'i rin po che'i phreng ba'i se mo ngo dang*/ de las ches ring ba'i do shal/ rked par rked rgyan nam 'og pag ces pa rin po che'i gzhung lnga'i bar rnams rin po che'i drwa bas sbrel zhing smad du za ra tshags mang po 'phyang ba/ dpung pa dang mkhrig ma dang zhabs dag la gdub bu rnams ni/ rin po che'i gzhung gsum gyi bar rnams rin po che'i phreng bas sbrel ba ste rin po che'i rgyan dang*/ dar dkar po'am sna tshogs kyi sham thabs kyis mdzes pa/ gdan gyi padma dang zla ba nas snod gzhal yas khang dang bcud lhar gyur pa'i bar la sems bzung ste/ mdor na rnam rtog rgyun chags kyi dug dang bral ba'i lta ba ngo bo nyid yang dag pa rgyud la skyes kyi bar la bsgom mo zhes ji ltar 'tsham pa bshad do// de rnams kyis bskyed pa'i rim pa dngos gzhi sems 'dzin dang bcas pa ste de ring gi dmigs rkang rnams bstan zin nas/ da dung bsgom pas nyams su blang ba'i tshul bskyar ba sogs 'dra'o// //nyi ma lnga par sems bskyed gsal gdab pa nas/ bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor zhar byung dang bcas pa ste lnga las zhes pa'i bar gyi sa bcad rnams nyi ma bzhi pa ltar brjod pa'i rjes su/ lnga pa bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor sogs bskyar/ da ni de ring gi dmigs rkang gsar du 'chad pa la/ gnyis pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa la/ rnam gzhag sogs nas zhi gnas kyi sems rtse gcig pa'i ting nge 'dzin ma thob kyi bar du bslab bo zhes pa'i bar 'dra ba las/ nyams kyi skye tshul rnams bla mas rim par ngo sprad ces pa'i don ni/ rnam rtog ngo shes kyi nyams yin no zhes pa'i rjes su/ de ltar byung yang bsgom 'phro mi bshol bar rtog pa 'phro gcod gang thub byed cing bsgoms pas rnam rtog gcig rting la gcig rgyu 'phro la bar skabs shig nas rnam rtog gi rgyu ba zhi mal song ba snyam byed/

yang de ma thag rtog pa rgyu ba snyam byed pa res 'jog tu 'byung ste/ nyams gnyis pa rong khung dog mo'i chu lta bu zhes rnam rtog ngal gso'i nyams yin no// slar yang de'i rgyun la nan tan gyis bsgoms pas ci zhig na rnam rtog gi rgyu ba ha phri rngugs pa ltar log nas lhan tshom gyis mi rtog par 'gro ba 'byung la/ de la rig pa'i ngar bton zhing bsgoms pas skabs 'gar shes pa'i dwangs cha dang bcas pa yod 'phro la yang rnam rtog tho lo lo skye ba 'byung ste/ nyams gsum pa phu gsum gyi rdzing chu lta bu zhes bya ba rnam rtog thang chad kyi nyams yin no// slar yang de'i 'phro mthud cing bsgom pas rnam rtog gi rgyu ba phal cher zhi nas sems rtse gcig tu nyal gyis gnas pa 'byung zhing*/ de'i ngang nas rnam rtog gcig mthud gnyis mthud re tsam 'byung yang de ma thag zhi bar 'gyur te/ nyams bzhi pa mtsho rlabs dang bcas pa zhes bya ba rnam rtog rlabs bcas kyi nyams yin no// slar yang sngar gyi rgyun de nyid la mnyam par bzhag pas rnam rtog gi 'phro 'du thams cad zhi nas sems rtse gcig tu gnas pa gsal cha dang bcas pa zhig 'byung ste/ nyams lnga pa mtsho rlabs dang bral ba lta bu zhes bya ba rnam rtog zhi ba'i nyams yin no// yang de la/ chos rje bla ma dam pas/ g.yo thob goms dang mthar phyin lnga// bsam gtan lam gyi skye tshul yin// ri gzar chu dang tsi ti dang*// rgan po sbubs kyi chu dang ni// ri bo lta bu'i dpe lngas bstan// zhes pa ltar/ dang po g.yo ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ bsgoms pas blo yi mi gnas pa gcig las gcig 'phro bas rtog pa mang du song ba snyam byed pa 'byung ste/ dper na ri gzar gyi chu bzhin no// de ni sgom skye bar 'dod pas rtog pa ngos zin pa yin no// gnyis pa thob pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ bar bar du cung zad rtog med du gnas pa ste/ dper na bya tsi ti bzhin no// gsum pa goms pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni/

rtog pa cung zad 'phro yang phal cher rtog med du gnas te/ dper na rgan po'i 'khar gzhong gi chus rus sbal bzhin no// de'i dus su rkyen gyis bsgom pa la gnod do// bzhi pa brtan pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ rtog med du rgya 'byams pa ste/ dper na sbubs kyi chu bzhin no// de'i dus su rkyen gyis mi gnod do// lnga pa mthar phyin pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ bsgom pa la gang gis kyang mi gnod cing*/ slar rkyen gyis bogs 'byin te/ dper na ri bo bzhin no zhes gsungs te/ gang ltar yang*/ de'i tshe rnam rtog gi 'jug pa thams cad zhi ste sems rtse gcig tu lhan ner gnas kyang shes pa'i dwangs cha gsal sing nge ba zhig ma rnyed na rnam rtog kha 'chim pa'i zhi gnas yin pas/ sems rtse gcig tu gnas pa shes pa'i dwangs cha gsal sing nge shar ba mar me rlung gis ma bskyod pa lta bu zhig ma byung gi bar du bsgom mo// de ltar bsgoms pas yul gyi steng du gsal cha khyad par can byung na/ dmigs rten la mi blta bar sems kha nang du bltas la shes pa'i gsal cha de nyid kyi steng du lhan gyis bzhag pas/ shes pa'i dwangs cha gsal sing ba de'i ngang du rtsol ba glod la lhug par bzhag ste/ mdor na sems tshul min yid byed kyi dbang du mi 'gro bar rtse gcig pa'i ting nge 'dzin ma thob kyi bar la bslab bo zhes pa'i bar brjod cing ngo sprad/ de rnams kyis de ring gi dmigs rkang rnams song nas/ da dung bsgoms pas nyams su blang ba'i tshul bskyar na/ rang rang gi sgrub pa'i khang par bsam gtan gyi spyod lam dang ldan pas/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te bskyed pa'i rim pa sems 'dzin dang bcas pa nyams su blangs nas/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i nyams len dngos la sogs nas bslab bo'i bar bskyar ba sogs 'dra'o// //nyi ma drug pa la sems bskyed gsal gdab pa nas/ bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor zhar byung dang bcas pa lnga'o zhes pa'i bar gyi sa bcad rnams nyi ma lnga pa ltar brjod pa'i rjes su/

gnyis pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa la rags pa rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang*/ phra ba rdo rje'i bzlas pa ste gnyis las/ gnyis pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa la rnam gzhag sogs bskyar nas/ da ni de ring gi dmigs rkang gsar du 'chad pa la/ gnyis pa lhag mthong ni/ bla ma gnyen gyi gsung thad so zhes sogs nas/ dpag tu med pa'i srid pa gcod par byed ces pa'i bar brjod/ de rnams ni de ring gi dmigs rkang ste/ da dung bsgoms pas nyams su blang tshul bskyar na/ rang rang gi sogs nas srid pa gcod par byed ces pa'i bar bskyar ba sogs 'dra'o// //nyi ma bdun par sems bskyed gsal gdab pa nas/ phra ba rdo rje'i bzlas pa ste gnyis so zhes pa'i bar gyi sa bcad rnams nyi ma drug pa ltar brjod pa'i rjes su/ gsum pa bskyed rdzogs zung 'brel phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes bsgom pa la/ zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gnyis so// de'i phyi ma la yul snang sems su sgrub pa/ sems snang sgyu ma dang rten 'brel du sgrub pa gnyis kyis brjod bral du nges shes bskyed pa las/ gnyis pa lhag mthong ni/ bla ma gnyen sogs kyis bskyar nas/ de rnams kyis gdan thog gcig tu bsgom pa'i man ngag nyams su blang ba'i tshul ma tshang ba med par bstan zin to// //da ni de ring gi dmigs rkang gsar du 'chad pa ni/ gnyis pa de las gzhan du bsgom pa'i man ngag nyams su blang ba'i tshul la/ 'khyer so gsum dang*/ rjes thob kyi rnal 'byor drug las/ dang po ni de ltar snod gzhal yas khang zhes sogs nas/ mnyam rjes thams cad la rgyas btab nas bsgom pa nyid gnad du che'o zhes pa'i bar gong na yod pa 'dir blangs la bshad/ gnyis pa rjes thob kyi rnal 'byor drug las/ bza' ba zas kyi rnal 'byor ni zhes sogs nas/ khrus kyi rnal 'byor ni/ bla med gzhan dang 'dra'o zhes pa'i bar te/ khrus ni man ngag rnam bshad sogs su bshad pa ltar bya ba'am/ ma byas kyang rnal 'byor drug gi zhar byung las/

sa bcad kyis dngos su ma bgrangs pas 'gal ba med par sems so// de rnams ni de ring gi dmigs rkang ste/ de nyid nyams su blang ba'i tshul da dung lan gcig bskyar na/ gong du bshad pa'i mnyam gzhag gi rnal 'byor las ldang bar 'dod na/ bzlas pa bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi rjes su byas pa'i dbang du byas na bzlas pa bsdu ba dang*/ gdan bsdu ba dang*/ gnas bsrung ba dang*/ dge ba 'di yis sogs kyis dge ba bsngos nas/ 'khyer so gsum ni sogs nas khrus yan chad bskyar ba dang bcas pa 'dra'o// //nyi ma brgyad par sems bskyed gsal gdab pa nas/ zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gnyis so zhes pa'i bar gyi sa bcad nyi ma bdun pa ltar brjod pa'i rjes su/ gnyis pa de las gzhan du bsgom pa'i man ngag nyams su blang ba'i tshul la/ 'khyer so gsum dang*/ rnal 'byor drug las/ dang po ni de ltar snod gzhal yas khang sogs bskyar nas/ da ni de ring gi dmigs rkang gsar du 'chad pa la/ lnga pa 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor la/ sbyor ba ni rgyas par na skyabs 'gro sogs nas/ rnal 'byor ma ni shin tu dkon zhes so// de rnams ni de ring gi dmigs rkang ste/ bsgoms pas nyams su blang ba'i tshul bskyar ba sogs 'dra'o// nyin grangs nyung bar 'dod na nyi ma bdun pa dang brgyad pa gnyis bsdom mo// //nyi ma dgu par sems bskyed gsal btab nas gong gi sngon 'gro rnams nas bzung ste lam yongs su rdzogs pa'i sa bcad rgyas bsdus gang rigs nas rjes thob kyi rnal 'byor drug go zhes pa'i bar nyi ma brgyad pa ltar brjod pa'i rjes su/ de'i lnga pa 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor la sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi gnyis/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gsum ste/ 'chi ba rim gyis pa la rim gyis nyams su blang ba'i tshul dang*/ 'chi ba cig car ba la btsan thabs su 'pho ba dang*/ skyon yon gnyis kyi sgo nas mjug bsdu ba'o// dang po la yang sbyang ba dang las la sbyar ba'o// gnyis pa las la sbyar ba la/

dus nam gyi tshe las sbyar ba/ tshul ji ltar las la sbyar ba/ de ltar 'byong pa'i phan yon dang gsum las/ lnga pa 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor la/ sbyor ba ni rgyas par na zhes sogs kyis bskyar nas/ da ni de ring gi dmigs rkang gsar du 'chad pa ni/ drug pa bar dor sangs rgyas pa 'od gsal gyi rnal 'byor la gsum las/ sbyor ba skyabs 'gro zhes pa nas sku gsum gyi bdag nyid rje btsun spyan ras gzigs kyi go 'phang mngon du byed par 'gyur ro// de rnams ni de ring gi dmigs rkang ste de dag gis khrid kyi rim pa rnams bstan zin nas/ de ring gi dmigs rkang de da dung lan gcig bskyar na/ drug pa bar dor sogs nas bskyar ba dang bcas pa 'dra'o// de rnams kyis grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po gnyen tshem bu pa dar ma 'od ces grags pa la ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro mas dngos su gnang ba'i gdams pa khyad par can thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid ces pa'i nyams khrid zab mo ma tshang ba med pa gsan pa yin pas rang dang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzod ces dang spro na bstan pa rgyas pa'i bsngo ba dang smon lam gyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o// 'dir smos pa'i zhag grangs ni mang nyung 'tsham pa cig gi dbang du byas pa yin gyi/ de las mang ba'am nyung ba la sogs pa ji ltar byed kyang des rigs 'gre shes par bya'o// slar smras pa/ phyogs dang phyogs bral zhing gi mngal khur du// mngon par lci byed gdul bya'i bsod nams kyi// mgron du thob gyur mtha' yas rgyal ba yi// thugs rje gcig tu bskyil ba pad dkar 'chang*// de yi go 'phang zla med yon tan gyi// mi zad nor bus khengs pa'i khang pa bzang*// myur bar 'dzegs la dka' ba med pa'i lam// bsil ldan ljongs su byon pa'i grub chen srol// gang de snod min gnas su 'khyams dogs nas// rdo rje 'chang de ngur smrig bla gos can// rnam par 'phos nas bzung ba'i gdams ngag gang*// rdzogs par nod pa'i skal ba mi dman grang*// de nyid mkhas grub gong ma'i bzhed pa dag

/'gal med gcig tu bsdebs pa'i bsdus don dang*// rgyas bshad nyams su len tshul ston pa 'di// nges don dpyid thig 'chad pa'i zur rgyan yin// bdag gis 'di byas ma 'brel nongs pa dang*// mong rtul rkang pa bkod pas blo ldan rnams// dges byar 'os pa min pa gang lags pa// sdig dang mnyam du bshags so bcom ldan 'das// tshul 'dir 'bad pa las 'khrungs dge ba'i tshogs// gter dang yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam gyi// rkang pas 'thung bzhin bstan dang sems can la// phan dang bde ba'i 'byung gnas byed gyur cig /ces pa thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs pas mdzad pa'i yi ge'i steng nas bshad pa'i tshe nye bar mkho ba nges don dpyid thig 'chad pa'i zur rgyan zhes bya ba 'di ni/ bcu phrag rig pa'i gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag 'jam dbyangs chos kyi bla ma buddha dzñā na'i zhal snga nas kyis 'di ltar gyis shig ces pa'i bka'i cod paṇa gtsug tu bcing ba la brten/ tshad med pa'i mkhyen rab dang thugs rje'i bdag nyid mkhan chen sangs rgyas dpal bzang pa'i drung nas 'di'i nyams khrid stsal ba'i skabs nas khrid gzhung de nyid dang rin po che dpal ldan don grub pas mdzad pa'i nyams len snying po rab tu gsal ba la sogs pa'i yig cha phan tshun mi 'gal bar bsdebs pa sogs bkas gnang ji ltar nges pa rnams bande tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas sde dge lhun grub steng gi chos grwa chen por bris pa dge legs rab tu 'phel bar gyur cig/ // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
